_comment: Reviewed exemptions for framework-header-parity-gate.py. Each entry is one framework-prefixed header spelling a language package emits that is NOT a registered wire name (datrix_codegen_common.generation.http_headers). A private spelling of a framework contract is a defect; an entry here records the one reviewed reason it is still allowed, and a new spelling never hides behind an old one because every entry is matched against a live spelling. Remove the entry in the same change that fixes the package.
